Boston Terriers

Breed History

Boston Terriers are small, friendly dogs known for their distinctive tuxedo-like markings, expressive faces, and playful personalities. Originally developed in the United States, they have become popular companion dogs because of their affectionate nature and manageable size. Boston Terriers usually have short, smooth coats that can be black and white, brindle and white, or seal and white.

Physical Traits

One of the most noticeable features of a Boston Terrier is its large, upright ears and short muzzle. Their compact bodies are muscular and energetic, despite their small size. They are often described as lively, intelligent, and entertaining. Boston Terriers generally enjoy spending time with their families and can form strong bonds with their owners.

Exercise and Activity

These dogs need regular exercise, but they usually do not require extremely long walks. Short walks, play sessions, and interactive games can help keep them physically and mentally stimulated.
